name: clickarr-brand-tools
description: Regenerates every file under brand/ from the SVG geometry in gen.js and the Inter font.

scripts.build: node gen.js .. .fonts/extras/ttf && python3 -I -c "from PIL import Image; Image.open('../web/icon-256.png').save('../web/favicon.ico', sizes=[(16,16),(32,32),(48,48)])"
